thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered PD-INC-4821 — inference-gateway 5xx error_rate > 12% in eu-west1 for 3m. Grafana: http://grafana/redwood/alerts/4821 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to rotation: oncall-sre

jay: acked — I'm on it, pulling traces and logs

maya: joining. any customer impact reported yet?

jay: seeing spike start ~2024-03-21T02:13:40Z. logs show repeated kvclient timeouts from gateway pods.

luca: FYI deploybot shows a canary roll of inference-gateway v2.3.7 at 02:13Z on eu clusters.

jay: suspect the canary changed connection params to KV which is causing connection churn. quick checks: /health OK but /predict returns 502s.

jay: ```
GET /health -> 200
GET /predict -> 502 x 25-40/s from gateway frontends
[ERROR] kvclient: timeout writing 10.0.3.12:1234 ctx=ctx-55ms
```

maya: confirming latency to KV backend climbed: p95 450ms -> 2.3s after canary.

zoe: support seeing customer reports about timeouts for embedding and batch endpoints; small number of paying customers affected.

jay: mitigation plan (quick): 1) pause/rollback canary -> v2.3.6, 2) scale gateway pool +2 pods, 3) flush local KV caches and warmers, 4) monitor.

luca: executing rollback via deploybot: `deploybot rollback inference-gateway canary --to v2.3.6` — started now.

deploybot: Rollback initiated by luca, job id db-8842. Expected ~60s to complete for canary units.

jay: scaling gateway: `kubectl scale deployment inference-gateway --replicas=8 -n prod-eu` — scaling up two pods.

luca: pushing small kvclient config patch to increase connection pool and re-enable keepalive for gateway pods in eu for the short term.

jay: status update: rollback finished, canary removed. old stable pods regained normal kvclient settings.

incident-bot: Alert action registered: rollback performed. Monitoring for error rate change.

maya: metrics: 5xx rate decreased 12% -> 6% within 90s after rollback + scale. p95 latency improved to ~220ms.

jay: current 5xx ~1.2% and trending down over last 3 minutes. continuing to observe.

zoe: sent outbound note to impacted customers: "We're investigating transient 5xx errors affecting some embedding/predict requests in eu-west1. Mitigation in progress; no data loss reported." Will follow up with status page update.

nate: creating follow-up ticket to investigate kvclient connection defaults and to harden canary preflight checks. Assigning to SRE infra.

maya: proposed immediate action items: - tighten canary rollout gating to include KV latency preflight, - add synthetic KV timeouts probe in eu, - add rollback automation for connection-param changes.

jay: plan to scale down the temporary +2 replicas in 20m if stable, keep 30m watch window.

luca: found logs showing `kvclient: dial tcp 10.0.3.12:1234: connect: connection refused` from some canary pods — suggests changed pooling semantics in v2.3.7.

jay: closing PD-INC-4821. Oncall will own post-incident follow-up. Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-4821 resolved by jay at 1723457189

zoe: will draft customer status and post to status.redwood.ai once I have final numbers.

maya: postmortem owner: nate. ETA for draft: EOD.
